verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a workflow automation platform, so the axis applies. The pack only shows AI agent nodes, LLM integrations and MCP nodes that users assemble into their own workflows. Those are developer building blocks, not a built-in assistant to which a user delegates tasks inside the product, so there is no direct evidence for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
